messages:
sasha_peopleops: Heads-up — Alex R (contractor) handed in resignation this morning. Last day: Fri 2026-04-10. Need to coordinate offboarding: equipment pickup, Slack/Okta deprovision, GitHub keys, access to Dedicated clusters, and COBRA/benefits info. cc @maria_it @lina_payroll :wave:

ben_eng: thanks. who owns repo/key revocations? also any running training jobs on his Dedicated pool?

maria_it: I can schedule equipment pickup in SF office. Laptop return window next Mon/Tue. I'll also revoke VPN certs and Okta session once deprovision ticket is approved.

sean_manager: I'll do a 30m handoff with Priya and drop docs in his OKR folder. please backlog any outstanding PRs to his reviewers.

lina_payroll: For contractors we do final invoice + last payout on next payroll run. Benefits/COBRA: contractors aren't enrolled but if there are any transition benefits we can confirm. I'll post exact dates once I see termination record.

ben_eng: On access side, request we revoke: GitHub SSH keys, personal access tokens, AWS IAM keys, and any long-lived service account keys he had for Dedicated clusters. Also check if he has any API tokens in shared vaults.

offboard-bot: Automated ticket created: OFF-4691 — offboard alex.r (assign: maria_it, ben_eng, lina_payroll). SLA: 3 business days.

maria_it: Commands I'll run after ticket approval:
```
# revoke ssh & github membership
./scripts/revoke-github-user.sh alexr
# rotate any shared service tokens he touched
/secrets/rotate --team inference --user alexr
```

maria_it: Note — we'll keep a 48h delay before deprovisioning to allow knowledge transfer if needed.

ben_eng: I'll audit CI jobs and any cron runners. If he owns any deploy keys, I'll rotate them tonight.

sasha_peopleops: Action items:
- maria_it: schedule pickup + revoke certs (owner)
- ben_eng: audit repos/CI + rotate keys (owner)
- lina_payroll: confirm final payout + benefits note (owner)
- sean_manager: handoff doc + exit interview scheduling (owner)

sean_manager: I'll set up exit interview with People Ops for Wed 2026-04-08 10am. If anyone wants to add questions ping me.

lina_payroll: Confirmed — final invoice should be processed on 2026-04-15 payroll unless earlier paperwork is provided. COBRA: N/A for contractor, will send termination confirmation email to Alex with last day and final invoice details.

maria_it: Once I run revocations I'll post the timestamp and list of removed access in this thread.

ben_eng: Also tagging eng-sre to ensure Dedicated capacity billing is reconciled and any reserved instances he used are transferred. @eng-sre please advise. :ok_hand:

sasha_peopleops: Thanks team. I'll follow up after exit interview and mark OFF-4691 done when all checklist items complete. :white_check_mark:
